release.body:
These builds aren't signed yet, so the first launch needs one extra step:
- **macOS:** open `Pomme.app` with right-click → Open, or allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.
- **Windows:** on the SmartScreen prompt, choose More info → Run anyway.
- **Linux:** `chmod +x pomme-client-linux-x64-gnu.AppImage`, then run it.


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at master -->

## What's Changed
* open the hopper, dispenser and dropper screens by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/866
* let the cursor go when the window loses focus, keep test windows off it by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/875
* fix missing chunks at high render distance by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/853
* render perf by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/872
* distant terrain by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/873
* Faster, responsive startup by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/876
* Drop unreachable boot screen fallbacks by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/877
* Footsteps and a generated block sound table by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/878
* Place, landing and splash sounds by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/879
* floor the player's position when finding its chunk column by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/856
* open the brewing stand and crafter screens by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/869
* lock each chunk column once per collision scan by @Chromatischer in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/894
* Tidy the install folder by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/895
* Close chat when the server opens a container by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/896
* fix third-person camera culling and player body rotation by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/885
* Show FPS through debug entries and Debug Options by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/883
* render item tooltips in containers and 3d player heads in menus by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/884
* render 3d nameplates for players and named mobs by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/886
* Bump pyronyx to 0.5.1 by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/897
* Load Vulkan at runtime and explain a renderer that can't start by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/887
* render sign text in world space and add sign edit screen by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/888
* render boat models, simulate steering, and handle passenger seating by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/889
* draw multipart blocks by their full conditions: redstone wire, shelves and chiseled bookshelves by @Chromatischer in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/890
* split the protocol translator by version and pick its rewrites from dispatch tables by @Chromatischer in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/891

## New Contributors
* @Chromatischer made their first contribution in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/894

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/compare/client-v0.2.9+26.2...client-v0.2.10+26.2

commit.message:
Draw chat, titles and subtitles under screens, and the debug overlay over them (#901)

* draw chat, titles and subtitles under screens, and the debug overlay over them

* draw nameplates under the HUD, subtitles under a dialog over a container

Adds a show_subtitles harness option and ui/hud shots for titles and subtitles against open screens.

* drop the screen-space nameplates the 3d name tags replaced

split the protocol translator by version and pick its rewrites from dispatch tables (#891)

* test(client): exhaustively compare native registry enums

Compare all ids and entry counts in every ClientRegistry against the runtime builtin enums.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol and Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5

* refactor(client): resolve game rewrites into dispatch tables

Select callbacks at table construction and validate every required packet name through all supported protocol constructors. The old-chain equivalence test passed all 1974 selections before removal. Retain packet-name and precedence checks.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol

* refactor(client): split translation rewrites by protocol

Move protocol rewrites, shared codecs, dispatch construction, inbound/outbound paths, and tests into translate/. Preserve function signatures and bodies apart from module visibility and formatting.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol

* refactor(protocol): generate entity serializer remaps by name

Extract registration order from SHA-1-verified Mojang jars and mappings with the protogen sibling tool. Generate all 15 embedded tables; remap by canonical serializer name and skip metadata through the native shape table. The temporary old-function comparison passed every id in 0..64 before deleting arithmetic remappers; retain those verified maps as a fixture. All tables reproduce byte-for-byte.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol and Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5

* refactor(client): own translation state per connection

Cache immutable translation tables in per-version OnceLocks. Give each connection its own dimension order and pending teleport acceptance, preserving state across reconfiguration and discarding it on reconnect. Add a regression that decodes logins across two successive connections and verifies the old dimension index is not retained.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol

* Keep the particle drop at debug, restore the dimension-type TODO and add just serializergen

---------

draw multipart blocks by their full conditions: redstone wire, shelves and chiseled bookshelves (#890)

* fix(client): evaluate multipart blockstate AND and OR selectors

parse_when_condition kept only string and bool values, so an AND or OR
selector became an empty map that matched every state: straight redstone
wire drew a dot, and shelves and chiseled bookshelves drew the parts for
every facing and fill state. Parse selectors into a condition tree with
alternatives, negation and nested AND/OR, and skip a malformed selector
with a warning instead of drawing it unconditionally.
tests/ingame/blocks/multipart_conditions shows all three blocks.

* Negate multipart terms one by one, reject empty terms and read combiners as the codec does
